newsitem.title: USA: Reliance Acceptance says CEO resigns.
newsitem.headline: Reliance Acceptance says CEO resigns.

text.p: Reliance Acceptance Group Inc said on Wednesday its chief executive officer and president Thomas Barlow had resigned and that Howard Silverman, the company's chairman, had assumed chief executive responsiblities.
In a statement accompanying its first quarter earnings results, the company also said it had begun a search for a chief operating officer.

Reliance Acceptance reported a 1997 first quarter net loss from continuing operations of $9.9 million, or $0.76 per share, compared with a profit from continuing operations of $3.2 million, or $0.21 per share in the year-ago period.
